Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a rear-end collision on a major roadway in Sugar Land, Texas. Driver 1 was stopped in traffic
when the rear of thier vehicle was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was traveling at a speed too high for the
conditions. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash, and the force of the impact appeared
sufficient to produce that kind of injury. Driver 2 acknowledged following too closely and stated that the collision
happened the way Driver 1 described. Two independent witnesses gave sattements that matched this account.
Officers photographed the scene and both vehicles. The damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle and the front of
Driver 2's vehicle lined up with the direction and severity of the impact, and officers found no prior damage to either
vehicle at the scene. A Passenger was also in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the witnesses and the responding officers
confirmed that person's presence at the time of the crash. Driver 1 was identified as the named insured on the policy
for the vehicle involved.
